svg.title: Video Template D BPM workflow — Personalized Birthday
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for Personalized Birthday. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Shared skeleton plus S1/S2 overlays; the source maps D but does not define a bespoke ordered graph. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.aria-label: Workflow title, profile and runtime status
g.text: Video Template D · Personalized Birthday BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Produce a privacy-aware personalized celebration video from
reusable variables, voice and visual templates. Single-recipient
or small-batch personalized greetings with lightweight
skeleton plus S1/S2 overlays; the source maps D but does not
L1 required; privacy, consent, template robustness and trust
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Capture recipient variables and creative intent.
• Choose S1 or S2 from batch and format needs.
• Confirm privacy, consent and expiry rules.
• Block missing consent or unsafe personal data.
• Freeze allowed merge fields and outlets.
Revise data scope, consent or delivery plan.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Write greeting script and pronunciation guide.
• L1 checks merge fields, layout and fallback values.
• Lock identity and voice consent state.
Template · script · variable map · consent state
Fix unsafe field or fragile layout.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Merge recipient variables into the template.
• Run identity, pronunciation and sync QA.
• No unapproved face or voice substitution.
• Each render retains a correlation ID.
Personalized renders · QA result · audit evidence
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Assemble greeting and optional music bed.
• Add captions, graphics and safe fallback copy.
• Prevent personal data leaking into metadata.
Fix the failed variant or fallback.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Test clarity and usability of personalized output.
• Scale-selected L2; consent gate is hard.
Return identity, privacy or UX issue.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Deliver through direct or CRM channel.
• Optionally create a share-safe social copy.
• Track delivery without exposing private fields.
• Recipient and channel scopes stay isolated.
• Failed delivery does not republish content.
Retry or repackage the failed delivery only.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Measure render success and delivery completion.
• Improve template robustness from defect patterns.
• Do not learn from private content without policy.
Delivery report · defect log · template tickets
Apply validated fixes to future templates.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Shared skeleton plus S1/S2 overlays; the source maps D but does not define a bespoke ordered graph.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 30 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
